descriptions.w3d_s20_forward_base_field_801a59c0: Appears to pass this and a field of the null-checked secondary base subobject to a helper.
descriptions.w3d_s20_forward_base_field_801aac8c: Appears to pass this, its second argument and a field of the null-checked secondary base subobject to a helper.
descriptions.w3d_s20_forward_base_range_801ad8fc: Appears to call a helper with the null-checked secondary base subobject, an item pointer and the item address plus 20.
descriptions.w3d_s20_apply_base_item_801a59f4: Appears to validate an item, then call two virtual methods of the secondary base subobject to apply it, returning zero on success.
descriptions.w3d_s20_lua_set_closure_field_801a0384: Appears to push a closure for a function plus a name and store it into the table at stack index minus three.
